description: This Java source file defines the MidiPortConnector class, which facilitates connecting MIDI ports between two remote devices in an Android environment. It provides methods for opening devices, establishing connections, and closing resources related to MIDI communication.

classes.name: MidiPortConnector
classes.description: A utility class to connect MIDI ports between two remote devices, handling device opening, connection management, and cleanup.

classes.name: MidiPortConnector.OnPortsConnectedListener
classes.description: Callback interface to notify when MIDI port connections are established or fail.

methods.name: MidiPortConnector
methods.description: Constructor initializing the connector with a MidiManager instance.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes active MIDI device connections and resources.

methods.name: safeClose
methods.description: Attempts to close resources while catching and logging IOExceptions.

methods.name: connectToDevicePort
methods.description: Overloaded method to initiate connection between two MIDI devices and their specified ports.

methods.name: connectToDevicePort (private)
methods.description: Establishes connection between a source device's port and a destination input port.
